content.title: Courier Type Run | Glow Trigger, Lateral Sprint and Message Landing
content.summary: An adult courier turns a signal cube into a neon sprint and landing statement. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One original adult stylized character and one luminous prop anchor the sequence. + All travel maintains one lateral direction and traceable light-gate order. + Typography follows action milestones instead of appearing as unrelated decoration. + The single jump is the motion peak and terminates in a readable impact location. + The final exact original statement shares the frame with the held character pose.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish one original adult stylized courier in darkness holding a cyan signal cube beside the exact vertical word "READY". Preserve identity and stride direction through three light gates whose spacing contracts toward the jump point. Hold the landing pose while the exact original statement "ONE STEP CHANGES THE MAP" fills the background.

All travel maintains one lateral direction and traceable light-gate order.
The single jump is the motion peak and terminates in a readable impact location.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult courier turns a signal cube into a neon sprint and landing statement. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用角色和一件发光道具建立动机，再让横向灯带变成连续冲刺路线；一次跳跃和重落把运动峰值转成准确原创短句，角色与字体在同一终态中保持可读。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One original adult stylized character and one luminous prop anchor the sequence.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One original adult stylized character and one luminous prop anchor the sequence."

invariants.rule: All travel maintains one lateral direction and traceable light-gate order.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "All travel maintains one lateral direction and traceable light-gate order."

invariants.rule: Typography follows action milestones instead of appearing as unrelated decoration.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Typography follows action milestones instead of appearing as unrelated decoration."

invariants.rule: The single jump is the motion peak and terminates in a readable impact location.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The single jump is the motion peak and terminates in a readable impact location."

invariants.rule: The final exact original statement shares the frame with the held character pose.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final exact original statement shares the frame with the held character pose."
